verdicts.reason: A keeps the can on its circle but there is no shared edge: the SOLSTICE wordmark floats off-centre to the right, the headline and body are left-aligned, and the badges and CTA are pushed right, with the SUMMER ONLY badge jammed against the right edge and touching the other badge. B has a clean left-aligned text column with strong headline hierarchy, but the backdrop circle has come loose from the can and sits at the bottom left behind the badges and CTA, which reads like a bug, leaves the can floating on bare background and leaves the CTA cramped near the bottom edge.
